source: ESPN core plays (sports.core.api.espn.com …/soccer/leagues/<league>/events/<id>/competitions/<id>/plays), recorded 2026-10-28, trimmed: clips from 8 entries before an event to 4 after it. Aston Villa v Manchester City (corners from each flag, every kind of shot, an offside, a booking at its foul, half time and the second half), Sunderland v Leeds (an injury delay and the substitution it forced), Crystal Palace v Newcastle (the goal VAR ruled out, a handball), Valencia v Villarreal (LaLiga: an injury, VAR's penalty, a VAR check that upgraded a card to red, a second yellow). Each match carries the summary's starting elevens (site summary `rosters`) and the commentary's added-time and half lines (site summary `commentary`, which the core plays don't have).
